t: You're looking at 1–6 Lombard Street, also known as the Scottish Provident Institution Building. It's an office building right next to Mansion House, overlooking Bank Junction in the City of London, and it's Grade II listed. It was designed by William Curtis Green, an English architect and barrister. His other works include the Dorchester Hotel, Wolseley House and New Scotland Yard. He received the Royal Gold Medal in 1942, and around twenty of his designs are now listed buildings.
